app.name: KhmerDub
onboarding.1.title: Dub any video into Khmer
onboarding.1.body: Import a clip, transcribe it with AI, and turn it into natural spoken Khmer — without a recording booth.
onboarding.2.title: Real Khmer neural voices
onboarding.2.body: Use Azure’s production Khmer voices or an installed Apple Khmer voice. Preview every line before you export.
onboarding.3.title: Your media stays yours
onboarding.3.body: API keys live in the iOS Keychain. Your video never touches our servers — only the AI provider you choose.
onboarding.privacy: No accounts. No tracking. No hidden uploads.
home.subtitle: What are we dubbing today?
home.hero.title: Make every video speak Khmer.
home.hero.body: AI transcription, natural translation, and studio-quality Khmer voiceover in one flow.
home.voiceCard.title: Khmer voice readiness
home.voiceCard.ready: Your Khmer voice is ready to record.
home.voiceCard.needsSetup: Add a voice engine to generate Khmer speech.
home.tip.title: Pro tip
home.tip.body: Keep each Khmer line close to the original speaking time. The exporter can gently fit speech to the timeline.
home.empty.title: Your first dub starts here
home.empty.body: Import a video or open the demo project to explore the studio.

transcribe.title: AI transcription
transcribe.subtitle: Time-coded transcription with your AI provider.
transcribe.noKey.title: Connect an AI engine
transcribe.noKey.body: Add an OpenAI-compatible API key to transcribe and translate. Keys stay in the iOS Keychain.
transcribe.uploading: Sending audio to your AI provider…
transcribe.replace.title: Replace the current script?
transcribe.replace.message: This project already has lines. Replacing removes the current script and Khmer translations.
transcribe.hint: For best Khmer results, use whisper-1 or a multilingual Whisper model.
transcribe.demoNoMedia: The demo has no source media. Import a video or add lines manually.

transcribe.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try a clearer recording.
translate.title: Translate to Khmer
translate.subtitle: AI localizes every line for natural spoken Khmer.
translate.noKey.title: AI engine needed
translate.noKey.body: Connect an OpenAI-compatible chat model to translate into Khmer.
translate.hint: The AI receives only your transcript and glossary — never your video.
translate.overwrite: This will replace existing Khmer text. Continue?

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Engine, voice, and studio defaults.
settings.ai.subtitle: Transcription and translation
settings.voice.subtitle: Azure and Apple TTS
settings.defaults.subtitle: Style, mix, and timing
settings.glossary.subtitle: Names and brand terms
settings.data.subtitle: Storage, exports, and permissions
settings.ai.keySaved: Key saved securely in the iOS Keychain.
settings.ai.security: KhmerDub sends requests directly from your device to the provider you choose. No proxy server, no analytics, no account.
settings.ai.keyNote: Your key is never included in project files or exports.
settings.voice.noApple: No Apple Khmer voice is installed. Azure is recommended for consistent results.
settings.voice.privacy: Voice text is sent only to Azure when you choose an Azure voice.
settings.data.confirm: This permanently removes all projects, media, and exports from this device.
settings.about.tagline: A private, Khmer-first AI dubbing studio.
settings.about.credits: Voices: Azure Neural TTS and Apple system voices. AI: your chosen provider.
settings.about.disclaimer: AI output can be imperfect. Review Khmer scripts and pronunciations before publishing.
settings.about.noTracking: No tracking. No ads. No accounts.
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.subtitle: Teach the translator your names, brands, and Khmer spellings.
glossary.empty.title: No glossary terms
glossary.empty.body: Add names or brand terms so AI keeps them consistent in Khmer.
glossary.hint: The glossary is included in AI translation requests. It never changes your source media.
privacy.title: Privacy by design
privacy.body: KhmerDub has no user accounts, analytics, ad SDKs, or tracking. Your projects live on this device.
privacy.keychain: API keys are stored in the iOS Keychain.
privacy.media: Source video and audio stay in the app’s Documents folder.
privacy.cloud: Only the transcript or voice text you choose is sent to your AI or TTS provider.
privacy.delete: Deleting a project removes its media, thumbnails, and exports from this device.
privacy.noTracking: No tracking, advertising, or third-party analytics.
privacy.cloudBody: Transcription sends extracted audio to your AI provider. Translation sends transcript text. Azure TTS sends the Khmer text. This happens only when you tap the action.
demo.title: Welcome to KhmerDub
demo.notes: A short demo script. Import your own media to make a full dub.
demo.original1: Welcome to KhmerDub, your AI dubbing studio for Khmer.
demo.khmer1: សូមស្វាគមន៍មកកាន់ KhmerDub ដែលជាស្ទូឌីយោឌឹប AI សម្រាប់ភាសាខ្មែរ។
demo.original2: Import a video, transcribe it with AI, and translate it into natural Khmer.
demo.khmer2: នាំចូលវីដេអូ ចម្លងសំឡេងជាអក្សរដោយ AI ហើយបកប្រែជាភាសាខ្មែរធម្មជាតិ។
demo.original3: Choose a Khmer voice and export a video that is ready to share.
demo.khmer3: ជ្រើសរើសសំឡេងខ្មែរ ហើយនាំចេញវីដេអូដែលអាចចែករំលែកបាន។
demo.original4: Every line is editable, so you stay in control of the Khmer script.
demo.khmer4: រាល់បន្ទាត់អាចកែបាន ដូច្នេះអ្នកនៅតែគ្រប់គ្រងអត្ថបទខ្មែរបាន។
demo.original5: Review, preview, and export. Your Khmer voice is ready.
demo.khmer5: ពិនិត្យ ស្តាប់ជាមុន និងនាំចេញ។ សំឡេងខ្មែររបស់អ្នករួចរាល់ហើយ។
